program:
alphabet a b

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_a@i & is_b@i, is_b@i & !is_a@j & is_b@j)
h1_2 = leftmost(!is_a@i & is_b@i & !is_a@j, !is_a@i & is_b@i)
h2_1 = rightmost(!h1_1@i & !is_bos@j, !h1_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j)
h2_2 = leftmost(is_a@i & !is_b@i & !h1_1@i & !h1_2@i & !is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j & !h1_1@j, is_a@i & !is_b@i & !h1_1@i & !h1_2@i & !is_bos@j & !is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j)
h3_2 = leftmost(!h1_1@i & h2_1@i & !h1_1@j & !h2_2@j, !h1_1@i & h2_1@i & !h1_1@j)
accept = !is_a & is_b & !h2_1 & !h2_2 & !h3_2

output accept
